steps.title: Rules that work
steps.body: In the opening, do three things: take the centre with pawns, develop each piece once, and castle. Moving the queen early or the same piece twice loses time.
White has taken the centre with e4. That already opens lines for the bishop and the queen.

steps.q: Which is a better second move for White after e4 e5?
options: Bring the queen out to h5
steps.why: A knight develops and attacks the pawn on e5.

options: The queen gets chased and you lose time
Queens are not allowed in the centre
steps.why: Each chase is a free developing move for them.

cards.prompt: What are the three opening rules?
solution: Take the centre, develop each piece once, castle.
cards.why: They give you a safe king and active pieces.
